description: STEP : Stations de traitement des eaux usées en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Agences de l'Eau, OFB, association AILE. Le système de traitement d'eaux usées est un ouvrage de dépollution des eaux usées par des procédés divers: biologiques, physico-chimiques... localisés sur un espace géographique continu et homogène. Il est de type urbain, industriel (privé) ou mixte en fonction de la nature du maître d'ouvrage. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Territoires. Its keywords are Eau, TEO, Pollution. The portal shows 1,017 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
